verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਊ ਦੀਪਕੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਅਛਤ ਹੀ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaa(n)jan kai jaise kouoo dheepakai dhurai raakhai ma(n)dhar mai achhat hee dhoosaro na jaaniee ||

en.bdb: If a beacon is lit but kept under cover, no one can see anything in that room despite the presence of an oil lamp there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਖਵਈਆ ਪੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਤਮ ਤਿਮਰ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਠਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau pai rakhavieeaa pun pragaT pragaas karai harai tam timar udhot jot Thaaniee ||

en.bdb: But he who has hidden the lamp removes its cover and light up the room, the darkness of room is dispelled.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਤਛਿ ਰੂਪ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਪਈਆ ਤਤ ਖਿਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sagal samagree gireh pekhiaai pratachh roop dheepak dhipieeaa tat khin pahichaaniee ||

en.bdb: Then one is able to see everything and even he who has lit the lamp can be recognised.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਟ ਗੁਪਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਉਨਮਾਨਈ ॥੩੬੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise avaghaT ghaT gupat jotee saroop gur upadhes unamaanee unamaaniee ||363||

en.bdb: Similarly, God resides latently in the tenth door of this sacred and invaluable body. By the incantation blessed by the True Guru and perpetual practicing on it, one realises Him and feels His presence there. (363)
